name: inventory-service
description: Stock catalogue for a small warehouse: products and their on-hand quantities.

modules.name: catalog
modules.description: Products that can be stocked and their current quantity.

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Stock keeping unit, unique per warehouse

decisions.title: In-memory persistence for the first slice
decisions.rationale: The first increment validates the API contract; PostgreSQL follows once the catalogue shape is agreed.

assumptions: One warehouse per deployment; multi-warehouse is out of scope.
open_questions: Should SKU uniqueness be enforced by the API or by the upstream ERP?
